svg.title: From a rough sketch to a figure in your thesis
svg.desc: You supply a rough sketch: three boxes, Collect, Analyze, and Report, joined by arrows. Redraw it in draw.io, save the .drawio file, and export a PDF. The clean version has tidy boxes and straight arrows; keep labels readable at final size. Add the PDF like any figure. The thesis page shows the diagram with its caption below it, in bold: Figure 2.3: Example workflow.
svg.text: keep labels readable at final size
